Prop 3 gives me Long Hump 6; Prop 4-5 gives faster colonizers now and faster warships later. Propulsion serves both the land-grab and the war phase, so it is the cheapest dual-use investment. STANDING PRIORITIES BY PHASE: 1) OPENING - build scouts + Santa Marias continuously. Target 5-6 colonies by 2110. Keep 2 scouts alive on permanent recon so I always know where e2's frontier is. 2) CONSOLIDATION (~2115-2135) - once 6+ planets, shift research to Weapons then Energy/Construction. Fortify any planet within 150ly of e2. 3) ENDGAME (2135+) - sustained offensive: hunt e2 colonies and shipping with massed warships, bomb and take their worlds rather than glassing them (planets owned is the victory metric). Keep a home defense squadron and defenses on the two highest-resource worlds. RULES I HOLD MYSELF TO: - Never starve the economy for warships before ~2120; a war fleet with no resource base loses the second engagement. - Never send an unescorted colonizer past a system with known enemy presence. - Rewrite this memo every turn with what I actually learned (hab values, e2 location, tech deltas).
